admin.title: Manage giving causes
admin.intro: Prepare a cause in English and Urdu. Publishing makes it visible on the giving pages from its start date.
admin.empty: No causes have been created yet.
admin.slugHelp: Use lowercase English letters, numbers and hyphens, for example school-supplies.
admin.scholar: Approving scholar’s name (optional, shown for Zakat-eligible causes)
admin.receiptPublicByDefault: Make new spending receipt photos public by default
admin.projectHelp: A project stays on the causes list. The projects page shows it only while that module is on.
admin.showProject: Show on the new projects page
admin.plannedHelp: Choose the first day of the month, or leave it empty.
admin.closeHelp: Closed causes stay visible in the public directory.
admin.settingsLocked: Dates, giving periods, and Zakat eligibility are locked for closed causes and causes with recorded funds.
admin.archiveConfirm: Archive this cause? It will stay visible under Past causes.
admin.archiveBlocked: This cause has recorded funds and cannot be archived until those funds are accounted for.
admin.duplicate: A cause already uses that page address.
admin.stale: The cause is no longer eligible for this action. Refresh and check its status and dates.
admin.invalid: Check the required translations, target and dates.
admin.unavailable: Cause management is unavailable at the moment.
